Environment, Health & Safety Internship
📍 Key Internship Details
Where Zwijndrecht, Netherlands
Start date Between November 2026 and January 2027
Duration Minimum 6 months
Working model Full-time, on-site
🌱 Grow Your Future at Kerry
At Kerry, our purpose - Inspiring Food, Nourishing Life - comes to life through science, innovation and sustainable nutrition . From food and beverage to pharma, our teams use insight, technology and science-backed solutions to help solve real-world challenges for people, society and the planet. Our impact reaches billions, but it starts with curious people, fresh ideas and teams who care about making a difference. If you’re looking for a place to learn, contribute and build real experience with purpose, Kerry could be the place for you.
🚀 Our Internship Programme Your First Step into Kerry
Our internships give you a real introduction to Kerry - our people, our work and the impact we’re creating through sustainable nutrition. With opportunities across Ireland, the UK and Mainland Europe , you’ll have time to learn, contribute and get a feel for where your career could go next. Demonstrate your potential during your internship and your application for our Graduate Programme will be fast-tracked.
📊 What You’ll Work On
As an Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Intern based in Zwijndrecht , you’ll support the EHS team with practical safety and environmental activities across our manufacturing site. You’ll gain hands-on experience in an international production environment where safety, quality and environmental responsibility are central to how we operate.
Supporting Risk Inventories & Evaluations (RI&Es) and Task Risk Analyses (TRAs).
Identifying high-risk activities and supporting risk assessments for contractors and maintenance work.
Joining safety walks and workplace inspections across the factory and production environment.
Supporting incident investigations and analyses, and helping identify practical preventive actions.
Contributing to safety advice and improvement measures on the shop floor.
Updating safety documentation, procedures and records.
Supporting toolbox talks and initiatives that build safety awareness.
Spotting opportunities to improve safety and environmental performance.
Working with operators, contractors and supervisors to support safe ways of working.
Supporting compliance with Dutch occupational health and safety legislation and Kerry’s internal standards.
Following up on actions arising from audits and inspections.
🔎 What We’re Looking For
You don’t need to have it all figured out. For this internship, we’re looking for someone who is proactive, eager to learn and ready to get involved in a hands-on manufacturing environment .
Studying Health and Safety, Safety Engineering, Chemical Engineering or a comparable degree.
Interested in safety, industry and manufacturing environments.
Proactive and keen to learn, with the confidence to identify improvement opportunities and ask questions.
Able to work independently while collaborating effectively with operators, contractors, supervisors and the wider EHS team.
Clear and confident in how you communicate safety information and practical recommendations.
English Fluent
Dutch language skills at B1 level or above .
Confident using Microsoft Office , including Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook, Teams and Copilot .
🌟 What’s in It for You
See the bigger picture real experience that helps you understand Kerry, our work in sustainable nutrition and how our people bring our purpose to life.
Build your network opportunities to connect with other interns, graduates and colleagues across Kerry.
Share your impact work on a project during your internship and present your contribution at the end of the programme.
Keep growing make a strong impact during your internship, and your application for our Graduate Programme will be fast-tracked.
📝 Ready to Take the First Step? Apply Now!
If this sounds like the kind of start you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you. After you apply, candidates who meet the requirements will be invited to complete a psychometric assessment. If successful, you’ll then be invited to a 30-minute virtual interview.
*Please note Applicants must have the right to work full-time in the Country they are applying for.
About Kerry
Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

66974.text:
📍 Key Programme Details
Start date September 2027
Structure you will be hired on a permanent contract, beginning with a 2-year rotational programme. You will complete two rotations across different RDA teams.
Location you will join one of our Kerry locations across Europe. Depending on your team and function, you could be based in Ireland, the UK, the Netherlands, France, Spain, Italy, Germany, Poland or Denmark. Please note that you may be required to relocate as part of your rotations, therefore we are seeking candidates who are internationally mobile
Working model on-site
🌱 Grow Your Future at Kerry
At Kerry, our purpose - Inspiring Food, Nourishing Life - comes to life through science, innovation and sustainable nutrition . From food and beverage to pharma, our teams use insight, technology and science-backed solutions to help solve real-world challenges for people, society and the planet.
Our impact reaches billions, but it starts with curious people, fresh ideas and teams who care about making a difference. If you’re looking for a place to learn, contribute and grow, Kerry could be the place for you.
🚀 Our Graduate Programme Your First Step Towards Leadership
The programme combines
Rotations complete two main rotations over the 2-year programme, building breadth of exposure and readiness for future leadership roles.
Leadership development develop formal leadership skills through dedicated learning modules and ongoing career-focused mentoring.
Strategic projects work on projects that help solve real business challenges and give you the chance to make a meaningful contribution.
Senior leader exposure gain access to senior leaders who will help inspire, motivate and connect you to Kerry’s purpose and strategy from the start.
Graduate networks build relationships through our global and regional graduate networks, connecting with other graduates across the business.
📊 Your RDA Journey at Kerry
As an RDA Graduate in Biotech Solutions , you’ll work with the scientific platforms and technical capabilities that sit behind Kerry’s innovation pipeline. You’ll help explore how ingredients, processes and emerging technologies can unlock better taste, nutrition, functionality and sustainability across future-focused food and beverage solutions.
Across your rotations, you’ll gain hands-on experience in technical and lab-based environments, learning how our RD&A teams investigate, test and scale foundational technologies that support product development and help shape the future of sustainable nutrition.
You could gain exposure to areas including
Ingredient functionality and process science
Biotechnology, fermentation and enzyme technologies
Analytical, sensory and technical evaluation
Bench-scale and pilot-scale trials to test and validate new technologies
Data, digital tools and AI-enabled ways of working in RD&A
Technical documentation, experimental accuracy and manufacturing readiness
Cross-functional project work with Development, Application, Food Craft, Regulatory, Quality and Commercial teams
🔎 What We’re Looking For
You’re a graduate or soon-to-be graduate, on track for a 21 degree or equivalent in Biochemistry, Microbiology, Biotechnology, Food Technology, Food Engineering, or a related scientific discipline
You’re ambitious, open-minded and ready to learn through hands-on, lab-based work and real customer innovation projects
You’re fluent in English and ideally another language
You’re excited by science, technology and new ways of working, and keen to use data, digital tools and AI thoughtfully to improve how products are developed, tested and scaled
You’re eligible to work permanently in Europe
You’re open to travel and relocation as part of the programme
Fluent in English and German
🌟 What’s in It for You
Competitive package a graduate salary and benefits package aligned to the country and location you join.
International experience opportunities to work with different teams, functions, and locations as part of a global business.
A long-term career path a permanent role from day one, with a structured programme designed to help you grow beyond your first placement.
📝 Ready to Take the Next Step? Apply Now!
If this sounds like the kind of experience you’re looking for, we’d love to hear from you!
Please apply for one graduate programme only, so we can consider your application for the opportunity that best matches your interests. Multiple applications will be withdrawn.
Our graduate selection process includes
Application review
Psychometric assessment
Short virtual interview
Final-stage virtual assessment centre
